import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
e=df['eps'].values;t=df['T'].values;s=df['sigma'].values
def run(name,g,npar,ntries=30):
    rng=np.random.default_rng(1);best=(9,None)
    for _ in range(ntries):
        p0=rng.uniform(-1.5,1.5,npar)
        def res(p):
            with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
                G=g(e,t,p)
            G=np.nan_to_num(G,nan=1e3,posinf=1e3,neginf=-1e3)
            X=np.column_stack([np.sqrt(t),G,np.ones_like(t)])
            c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,s,rcond=None)[0]
            return s-X@c
        try:
            r=least_squares(res,p0,max_nfev=300)
            v=np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(s)
            if v<best[0]: best=(v,np.round(r.x,4))
        except Exception as ex: pass
    print(name,best)

        p0=rng.uniform(-1.5,1.5,npar)
        def res(p):
            with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
                G=g(e,t,p)
            G=[np.nan_to_num(x,nan=1e3,posinf=1e3,neginf=-1e3) for x in G]
            X=np.column_stack([np.sqrt(t)]+G)
            c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,s,rcond=None)[0]
            return s-X@c
        try:
            r=least_squares(res,p0,max_nfev=400)
            v=np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(s)
            if v<best[0]: best=(v,np.round(r.x,4))
        except Exception as ex: pass
    print(name,best)
